description:
Gripper 1.21 + handles 2.6 (from 1.20 gripper + 2.5 handles, which Jake likes). Jake, in substance: "Extend the black piece where my finger rests all the way up to where the profile starts to go out again. Where it goes out again, make it more of a single jump out: no double indent, just out and then back in."

Versions: next free are 1.21 and 2.6 (latest: v020 = 1.20, v205 = 2.5; nothing in flight). This touches BOTH parts, so make both:
- 1.21 (gripper/finger outline): the 'go out again' is on the finger's outer edge above 1.20's top hook — the top hook notch (top_hook_mirror_u, floor at u 28.4), its ramp back onto the edge (lands u 36.5), then the blade-root bend/S-curve. That reads as the double indent. Replace it with one clean step: out once, then back in. The top hook has to move up to (or become) that step so the handle can reach it.
- 2.6 (handle plate, the black piece): on 1.21's fingers, the handle plate runs from the base hook up to that new single step (longer than 2.5's 41.8 mm floor-to-floor span), keeping 2.5's slide-in-across-the-finger fit and stop strip.

Follow AGENTS.md: copy v205_generalist_spanning_handle, change params.json (add params for the new step rather than literals), regenerate, check_geometry, register in Scripts/publish_designs.py and cad/mobile_gallery/poses.js. Also record 1.21 in VERSIONS.txt. Show Jake 2.6 next to 2.5 from the same angle.

results.identified_issue: Interpretation: 'where the profile starts to go out again' = 1.20's blade-root S-curve start (outer edge w min at u ~53-56 in rail coords); 'double indent' = 1.20's top notch + the dip between its ramp and the S-curve. top_hook(Q) in trace_photo.py now takes the outline built so far: straight rail points from u 20 to the mirrored hook's start, the mirrored base hook up to its crest (argmax w), then a cubic (handles L/2 level at the crest, L/6 along the edge at J) to J = the first outline point past the crest whose w >= crest - top_step_back. Rejected: a plain square shoulder (no outboard capture for the handle's top foot) and keeping the hook's back + rejoining at the dot (leaves a dip, i.e. still a double indent). If Jake meant 'back in' as the edge dropping back right after the step, raise top_step_back. Not checked: the wider shoulder vs a hand or objects; RDP_SPLIT is still 1.19's value (mesh checks pass).
results.summary: Made 1.21 + 2.6: the outer edge now runs straight up to one step out where the blade widens, and the black handle runs all the way up to it (67.4 mm, was 41.8)
results.detailed_description:
New folder v206_generalist_single_step (2.6; its fingers are 1.21 — I didn't make a separate 1.21 folder, the finger STLs here are 1.21, noted in VERSIONS.txt).

Finger (1.21): I moved the top hook from u 28.4 up to u 54, right where 1.20's edge used to start going out. The outer edge is now one straight line from the base hook to there (it fills in 1.20's ~1 mm dip between u 36 and 56). At u 54 the same mirrored J-hook curls out to its crest, 6.6 mm out, and the edge then stays out at that level (it sags 0.3 mm) until the beak's outer edge comes back up to it near u 77; the beak then carries on and rounds back in to the point. So the old notch → ramp in → dip → S-curve climb (the double indent) is now one jump out. Trade-off to look at: ahead of the hook the finger is up to ~3 mm wider on the outboard side than 1.20, because the step is filled level instead of dropping back in.

Handle (2.6): same plate, feet, strap slots, stop strip and slide-in-across-the-finger as 2.5, just longer: 67.4 mm floor to floor (2.5: 41.8). Strap slots stay centred.

Two new params in params.json, both on the Tune panel: top_notch_u (54; replaces top_hook_mirror_u, slides the hook and the handle length together) and top_step_back (0; raise it to let the back of the step dip and rejoin the edge sooner if the shoulder looks too bulky). All export/genus/geometry checks pass. Registered in publish_designs.py and poses.js. Side by side with 2.5 from the same camera: previews/compare_v205.png. Nothing printed.

summary: Replace the double indent above gripper 1.20's top hook with one clean outward step, and make a longer handle plate 2.6 that reaches it. The finger-rest black piece must extend up to where the profile goes out again, with the step being just out and back in.
